ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Afya Project-Health Education Advocacy This civic commitment initiative provides meaningful learning and engagement opportunities for undergraduate students work with community women to (1) recruit local African American women to become health educator-activists; (2) engage community women, students and faculty in research and development of a grassroots health empowerment curriculum and training program; (3) implement the curriculum through øTupperwareø style house parties; and (4) evaluate the effectiveness of this project for expansion and replication. This course addresses the theoretical base needed to develop facilitate behavior change and well-being in the African American community. This course will meet in Huff Hall room 211-S.
